sections.description: Take Interac e-Transfer payments: customers get the amount, email, security question and answer with copy buttons; orders wait on hold (stock held) until you mark them paid, with reminders, auto-cancel, business-day deadlines and an e-Transfers inbox. Free, no add-ons.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

Now GWN Email Money Transfer (folder and slug gwn-email-money-transfer), with the e-Transfers inbox and business-day deadlines built in, so there's no Pro add-on any more. Installing it switches off GWN e-Transfer and GWN e-Transfer Pro; settings, orders and the gateway id carry over.

Added

  • Signed automatic updates again, from gwn-email-money-transfer/info.json on the releases repo. The WordPress.org build (WPORG=1 bin/build-zip.sh) leaves the updater out.
  • Admin screens credit Great White North Design and link to the docs at greatwhitenorthdesign.ca/tools/email-money-transfer/. Nothing customer-facing changed.
  • WordPress.org listing assets in .wordpress-org/ and bin/deploy-wporg.sh, which runs on release once the SVN secrets are set.

Changed

  • Plugin home moved to greatwhitenorthdesign.ca/tools/email-money-transfer/.
  • Each release also refreshes a fixed-name download, which the website links to: gwn-plugin-releases/raw/HEAD/gwn-email-money-transfer/gwn-email-money-transfer.zip.
  • Admin notices use the plugin's current name.

1.2.0

Free edition, ready for WordPress.org. The e-Transfers inbox and business-day deadlines move to GWN e-Transfer Pro.

Added

  • Setup check at the top of the payment settings; example addresses like payments@yourstore.ca count as not set.
  • Undo for "I've sent it" (15 minutes).
  • Settings for the checkout button text and wording; "How to send it" can collapse on phones.
  • "Shop again" on cancelled orders; shorter on-hold email intro.

Changed

  • GPL licence, no self-updater; CSS and JS load as files; every string is translatable.
  • Interac logo off by default; default title "e-Transfer". Settings grouped into Receiving account, Security answer, Timing, Wording and Look.

1.1.0

First release as a standalone plugin for any WooCommerce store.

Added

  • Signed automatic updates. Stores update from the GWN releases page; each zip's signature and checksum are checked before it installs. Auto-updates switch on once, with a notice and a link to turn them off.
  • Clean uninstall. Deleting the plugin stops pending reminders and auto-cancels. Order history is never removed; gateway settings are kept unless GWNET_REMOVE_SETTINGS_ON_UNINSTALL is defined.

Changed

  • Plugin header: Update URI, so WordPress.org can never offer an unrelated plugin as an update.

1.0.4

Built for PouchPlug: Interac e-Transfer gateway (classic + block checkout), pay panel with copy buttons and countdown, per-order security answers, "I've sent it" button, reminder + auto-cancel, and the WooCommerce → e-Transfers matching screen.
